title: Ported matrix-game to vulkan on windows, realizing that this may really become a thing soon.
author: ogimaru
selftext:
Recently I've been playing around with real-time diffusion, especially for image edit model, and came across this [https://matrix-game-v4-0.github.io/page/](https://matrix-game-v4-0.github.io/page/) . When they started out, I was thinking it's a silly idea -- but it's really starting to become feasible when introducing a proxy low-poly environment. Really an interactive world model.   
  
Porting it to vulkan for both the rendering and the compute shaders - it's really difficult to get on-par with CUDA, but we're at least getting 30fps on an rtx4080!
